verdict.rationale: Khoj's source is public on GitHub at khoj-ai/khoj, and a community user reports reading the code there. Another commenter identifies the license as GPL-3, an OSI-approved open license, and the project is branded open-source. Critics of that branding were objecting to its OpenAI dependency, not to source availability. Missing for 10: a first-party statement of the license (e.g., a LICENSE file or docs page) in the evidence, and documentation on navigating or contributing to the source.
